title: NYT Analysis: Saudi Arabia Faces Limited Options as Houthis Escalate Strikes on Civilian Targets
detail: A New York Times analysis finds that Saudi Arabia faces a limited set of credible responses as Houthi forces escalate strikes against core Saudi civilian and economic targets, including Riyadh airport. The assessment underscores the pressure on Saudi Arabia and its Mecca Pact partners to find an effective deterrence posture.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia faces limited options as Houthis escalate strikes on Riyadh airport and civilian targets

title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey Issue Joint Demand to End Houthi Attacks
detail: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey jointly demanded an end to Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, signaling a significant widening of multinational diplomatic alignment against the strikes. Egypt's participation is notable as it has been named a prospective accession candidate to the Mecca Defence Alliance; the joint statement represents the broadest multi-country front assembled against Houthi aggression since the pact's signing.

media.caption: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Turkey demand end to Houthi attacks in joint statement
